parameters.label: Solid panel finish
parameters.question: What finish for the solid façade panels?
parameters.explainer: Every panel that is not clear glass gets this finish: bush-hammered concrete like the 1970s building, aluminium, or fritted (dotted) glass.

parameters.label: SE studio glass
parameters.question: How much of the SE studio wall stays glass?
parameters.explainer: Share of the 142 studio window panels facing the quad that stay clear glass. The rest become solid panels, starting at the edges of each bay.

parameters.label: Sunshade fins
parameters.question: How deep are the sunshade fins on the SE glass?
parameters.explainer: 30 new concrete fins on the SE studio windows, two per bay, against the low morning sun. 0 means no fins.

parameters.label: Roof lanterns
parameters.question: How many of the 12 roof lanterns stay glazed?
parameters.explainer: The north-light lanterns bring daylight into the top-floor studios. A closed lantern gets a solid panel.
